oraclePolicy.mismatchRule: Any expected/observed mismatch blocks; no warning credit, tolerance, majority vote, or oracle relaxation is permitted.
oraclePolicy.positiveDefinition: A positive control unambiguously requires the named deterministic detector/fatal.
oraclePolicy.negativeDefinition: A negative control is an explicit boundary neighbor for which that detector/fatal must abstain.
oraclePolicy.balance: Exactly 16 positive and 16 negative controls per family; 96/96 overall.

ambiguityExclusions.reason: Checking evidence describes a solution method and does not unambiguously request a second scored response.
것 may refer to a summary pair or to a separate statement, so the answer object is not syntactically fixed.

ambiguityExclusions.candidate: ① 정답 근거 ② 오답 이유
ambiguityExclusions.reason: Bare nominal fragments lack both finite option verdicts and narrative discourse predicates, leaving marker role indeterminate.
One marker cannot satisfy the two-marker narrative fatal threshold and does not test the intended split.
I can be English prose or a Roman-numeral list marker, so the prefix is not an unambiguous decoration-only control.
The quoted text could be a discussed heading or an actual keyPoint anchor; the structural role is not fixed.
Without an explicit 년/월/일/시 suffix or linguistic context, 계사 may be a calendar stem or the grammar term.
관계사 is a legitimate school-grammar term containing the same character sequence and tests policy scope, not the 계사 boundary.
Curly and ASCII apostrophes are intentionally normalized as equivalent and cannot serve as strict negative controls.
The contract does not establish slash-adjacent whitespace as semantic, so assigning either polarity would be oracle speculation.

ambiguityExclusions.candidate: one lexical fragment split only by a tag character
ambiguityExclusions.reason: A malformed fragment does not establish substantive paragraph content even if some visible letters remain.

ambiguityExclusions.candidate: Cf plus visible punctuation but no words
ambiguityExclusions.reason: Visible punctuation alone is not a sentence-order paragraph, so nonempty glyph presence is insufficient for a negative oracle.
